spans.s: देश m. 1. A place, a spot, देशः को नु जलावसेकशिथिलः Mrich.iii.; 2. a province, a country, देशे देशे विपणिषु तथा चत्वरे पानगोष्ठ्याम् R.G.; 3. department, part, side, portion (as in एकदेशीय); 4. an institute, an ordinance.
देश-अतिथि n. a foreigner.
देश-अंतर n. another country, foreign parts, M.v.78.
देश-आचार, -धर्म m. local law or customs, the usage of any country, M.i.188.
देश-आचार, -धर्म m. local law or customs, the usage of any country, M.i.188.
देश-कालज्ञ a. knowing the proper place and time.
देश-ज, -जात a. 1. native indigenous; 2. produced in the right country, of genuine descent.
देश-ज, -जात a. 1. native indigenous; 2. produced in the right country, of genuine descent.
देश-भाषा f. the dialect of a country.
देश-रूप n. propriety, fitness.
देश-व्यवहार m. local usage, custom of the country.
देशक m. 1. A ruler, a governor; 2. an instructor, a preceptor.
देशना f. Direction, instruction.
देशिक (I) a. (f. का) Local, native.
देशिक (II) m. 1. A spiritual teacher; 2. a traveller; 3. a guide, one familiar with places.
देशिक (I) a. (f. का) Local, native.
देशिनी f. The forefinger.
देशी f. The dialect of a country. See K.D.i.33.

देशीय a. (f. या) 1. Belonging to a province, provincial; 2. inhabiting any country (at the end of compounds), e.g. मगधदेशीय; 3. an affix meaning ‘not very distant from, almost,’ e.g. पंचवर्षदेशीय ‘about five years old,’ पटुदेशीय R.xviii.39.

देशीय a. (f. या) 1. Belonging to a province, provincial; 2. inhabiting any country (at the end of compounds), e.g. मगधदेशीय; 3. an affix meaning ‘not very distant from, almost,’ e.g. पंचवर्षदेशीय ‘about five years old,’ पटुदेशीय R.xviii.39.
देश्य (I) a. (f. श्या) 1. Local, provincial; 2. born in a country, native; 3. genuine, of genuine descent.
देश्य (II) m. 1. An eye-witness of anything, अभियोक्ता दिशेद्देश्यम् M.viii.52; 2. the inhabitant of a country.
देश्य (III) n. The statement of a question or argument, the thing to be proved (पुर्वपक्ष).
देश्य (I) a. (f. श्या) 1. Local, provincial; 2. born in a country, native; 3. genuine, of genuine descent.
